thread:
Tara V: We need a compact launch playbook for the benchmark webinar + follow-up drip. Goal: webinar watches (live or recorded) and demo starts. Thinking 3-part campaign: announce, reminder, post-webinar nurture. Low friction, clear CTAs. Thoughts?
Mason Lee: Keep announce short: key stat + one-click register. Reminder: show top 2 takeaways and calendar add. Post-webinar: two paths: watched -> trial invite, didn't watch -> on-demand + 5-min demo clip.
Sofia Rios: Segmentation: pre-registers, new signups last 7d, existing customers (exclude). Use separate subject lines and CTAs. Example subjects: "See the Redwood benchmark" / "Quick clip: how we cut tokens".
Liam O'Connor: Ops checklist:
```
- Build 3 templates (announce, reminder, post)
- Create segments and suppression lists
- Add UTM: utm_campaign=bench_launch_q3
- Implement watch webhook to mark watched=true
- QA dry-run to 200 internal
```
Tara V: A/B test idea: subject with stat vs subject with how-to. Run on new signups cohort.
Mason Lee: Metric guards: open>30% or pause, click>6% or iterate. Watch rate tracked as `bench_webinar_watched`.
Sofia Rios: Copy notes: keep each email under 100 words, 1 primary CTA, include a 30s teaser GIF for announce (fallback to static image).
Liam O'Connor: Scheduling: announce at T-7 days, reminder at T-1 day + 2hr before live, post at T+1 day. Also send on-demand link immediately to those who registered but missed the live.
deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled for 2024-07-10 09:00 PT to list staging-marketing. Reminder 15m prior.
Tara V: Great. Sofia will draft copy, Mason will wire tracking & segments, Liam will push templates and schedule. We'll review dry-run results and finalize go/no-go.
